Mid close-up of the sleeper from the foot of the bed, with a large blanket in the foreground. The door is partly cut off at the upper right, with the fists mid-swing and motion lines but no knob.

rev.grid.png: Wide, level front view of five laughing riders lined up in a row with small exhaust flames at each bike; the only cell that shows all five riders together, but it is static and the engines are the least dramatic.

Low, close three-quarter front shot of the bearded rider popping a wheelie with a huge exhaust blast and speed lines; the other riders are small in the corners, and it is the most dynamic engine moment.
Extreme close-up of a gloved fist twisting the throttle with a burst of spark, and only two small riders are visible low in the corner; no exhaust is shown and most revelers are hidden.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind a cap-wearing rider, with a big exhaust blast in the foreground and three cheering riders ahead; the engines roar but the shot is mostly his back and head.
Medium front shot of the blond rider standing on the pegs with a fist raised, cheering, while the cap rider and the bandana woman flank him; the exhaust puffs are small and only three riders show.
Side-on tracking shot at speed of two riders, the bandana woman and the bearded man, with big overlapping exhaust bursts, motion lines and dust; only two revelers, but the loudest engines.
Rear three-quarter view of riders speeding away through a spray of gravel and dust, with exhaust flames on three bikes; faces are mostly hidden, so the cheering barely reads.

Tight, low close-up of four riders with fists raised and arms around each other, laughing, with flames at the exhausts below; the most cheering faces, but the bikes are cropped and the wheels dominate.
Top-down aerial view of three riders circling with exhaust flames and dust trails; faces are hidden, so no cheering shows, and it is the only overhead angle.
rigged.grid-2.png: Medium side view of a smirking clerk at a desk, sliding a ballot into the box with a stack of papers on the left; wig, clerk and box all visible, box closed and not shown overfull.
Low angle from in front of the box, with the box's front hiding the clerk's lower body; a worried clerk pushes ballots in, wig fully visible, box looks plain rather than stuffed.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind, so the wig dominates and the face is mostly hidden; the box is cropped at the right and bottom and doesn't look stuffed.

High-angle top-down view with both hands cramming ballots into the slot, loose ballots on the desk (left and right); box mostly visible and the ballots look overstuffed, but the bottom edge is cut off.
Extreme close-up on a grimacing face with tongue out and ballots in hand; wig cropped at the top, box only a thin strip at the bottom, so the box's fullness is hidden.
Full-body side view in a room, nervous clerk leaning over the box; whole wig and the entire box shown, but only a few ballots, so it doesn't look stuffed.
Front view, both hands pressing down on ballots that overflow the slot, so the box reads as full; wig and clerk fully shown, with the box centred and complete.
Tight profile from the left, with the clerk's face squeezed in and the box cropped at the right; ballots barely poking in, wig partly cut off at the left and top.

Box lid is propped open, showing the box crammed with loose papers, the best view of the stuffed or fixed box; a sweating clerk holds the lid and the wig is shown, but the box's bottom left is cut off.
rung.grid.png: Full-body side view from a slightly low angle: she smiles up as she lifts one foot toward the bottom step (yellow) and grips it. The whole girl and the ladder's lower half are visible, with no fence.
Extreme low angle from just below: smiling face and both hands gripping the yellow bottom step, with the ladder receding upward. Her legs are cut off, so only the shoe tip shows.
Tight overhead close-up of two hands on the yellow bottom step. Her face and the rest of the ladder are not visible, and only a sliver of shoe shows.
Back view close-up: her head and shoulders fill the frame as she reaches the bottom step, and her face is hidden. The ladder is cropped, with the legs and ground cut off.
High overhead top-down view: she looks up at the camera, smiling, with one hand on the yellow bottom step. The ladder is almost entirely out of frame, with only the bottom rung and rails at the base.

Pure side profile, full body, early in the action: she leans forward with both feet on the ground and a hand just touching the bottom step. This is the earliest moment, before any foot is on the ladder, and the whole ladder is not shown.

Rear three-quarter full-body view with a fence behind: she is already climbing, one foot on the bottom step and a hand reaching a higher rung. Her face is hidden, and this is a later moment than cells 1 and 5.
Tight side close-up of her laughing face and one hand on the yellow step. The ladder is cropped and her body is cut off, so it is mostly a face shot.
Low rear view looking up the ladder: she is high up with a foot on the yellow bottom step and her face hidden. It shows the full ladder run, and her head is cropped near the top.
ridge.grid.png: Straight-on, mid-distance view of the fridge alone on a long, flat-topped cliff crest, closed door, daytime, with small peaks behind it.
Close low-angle shot looking up at the fridge towering over a small rocky mound; the crest is cut off, so no long narrow crest shows (as in cell 4).
Top-down aerial view that shrinks the fridge to a small cube on a long, narrow ridge, so the fridge's doors and shape are barely readable.
Close, eye-level view of the fridge with its door open, showing empty shelves, on a small rocky mound; the crest is hidden, so no long narrow ridge shows (like cell 2).
Head-on view along a long, narrow ridge receding to the horizon, with the closed fridge alone in the middle. It shows the crest's length and narrowness better than any other cell.
Low-angle view from below the cliff face; the fridge is cropped to its upper half behind the edge, and only part of the crest shows.
Sunset version with an orange sky and sun, showing the small fridge alone on a long cliff crest. It is the only warm-lit, evening shot.
Snowy peak with the fridge's door open and snow on its roof, on a short summit with no long narrow crest. It is the only wintry shot.
Wide, far-away shot where the fridge is a tiny speck on a long crest above layered blue mountains; the fridge is hard to see.
saturation.grid.png: Wide, eye-level view of the satchel on dry-looking ground with only small puddles; it looks the least soaked, with few drips and a muted sky, and the whole bag and strap are in frame.
Low, close three-quarter view with the satchel sitting in a rain-pocked flooded puddle; the bag is cropped at the left and bottom, and heavy streaks and drops fill the frame.

High top-down view into the open satchel, showing rations, bottle and a tin (the others don't show the tin) standing in water. The flap is open, so the soaked rations are plainly visible, but there's no sky.
Eye-level view with a canvas tent filling the background; the satchel is dripping, with a small puddle at its base and only light rain visible.
Extreme close-up of the flap and buckle with water streaming and dripping off; rations and bottle are cropped at the top, the strap and puddle are cut off, and there's almost no rain or sky.
Eye-level view with a wooden fence behind the satchel and a rippling puddle in front; the bag is wet and dripping, and the rain is moderate.

High-angle view with the satchel tipped open and three ration packs spilled out into the puddle, plus a tin and bottle; the bag is the least waterlogged-looking here, there's no sky and the rain is only light.
Wide eye-level view of the dripping satchel in a puddle with a field and tree line behind it; rations and bottle are visible, the strap is in frame, and rain and ripples are clear.

Tight, slightly low view with the satchel filling the frame, water pouring off the flap, and the strap partly cut off; it shows the rations and bottle at the top edge and dense rain and ripples around the base.
scalpel.grid.png: Medium shot from the side with the surgeon's whole head and mask visible, the scalpel touching the bald head and the other hand steadying it; the patient's face is in the lower corner, which no other cell shows.

Tight close-up of the scalpel tip and a thin red incision line on the gleaming scalp, with the surgeon's face blurred and cut off at the upper right; similar to cell 7 but with no sparkle mark and the cut a bit longer.

Low-angle view from below the scalp with the raised scalpel held up and unused, no cut yet; the surgeon stares wide-eyed over the dome, like cell 8 but closer, with a plain background and no green circle.

Top-down view from above the head with the surgeon's face cut off at the top; the blade is touching the scalp and a vertical incision line runs down the middle, and both gloved hands and the patient's closed eyes are visible.

Wide establishing shot with an operating lamp and the patient lying on a table; the surgeon leans in with the scalpel at the forehead, and it's the only one that shows the whole room and body, so the scalp is small.
Extreme close-up of the surgeon's intense eyes over the mask, with the blade tip just touching the scalp at the moment before the cut; no incision is visible and the glove is mostly cut off.
Tight close-up like cell 2 but with a sparkle mark beside the blade, the surgeon's face blurred and half cut off, and a shorter incision curving across the gleaming scalp.
Low-angle shot with the surgeon wide-eyed and the scalpel raised in a flourish, a faint cut line already on the dome and a green circle behind; the surgeon is fully in view, unlike cell 3.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the surgeon's head, whose cap and ear fill the left; the hand holds the blade at the far side of the scalp, and the surgeon's face is hidden, which every other cell shows.

lines: Medium full-body side shot, eye-level: man mid-lunge with hand reaching toward the phone, which tumbles in the air with the shatter mid-burst; shh finger, screen and phone all visible; table at right like cell 6.
Wide shot from the floor looking toward a doorway: man tiny in the background with a small shh and reaching hand; phone huge in the foreground, tilted, screen cracked, shards scattering.

Dramatic low angle from below, tilted: man looms over the phone with his hand reaching out, and the shh finger is clear; phone shown on the left with shattered screen and shards flying; no floor visible.
Top-down overhead view: man crouched and looking down with shh finger; phone already lying flat on the floor in a sea of shards, the aftermath and not mid-fall; his body is cropped by the frame.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the man, who is large and cropped; his hand is open at left and the shh finger is partly hidden; phone is small and distant mid-air, back of the head hides his face.
Close medium side shot, tighter than cell 1: man leaning in with his arm outstretched, shh finger and one eye visible; phone mid-fall with a cracked screen and a few shards; his legs are cropped.

Extreme close-up of the face and shh finger at table level; phone at left is cut off by the frame edge, showing the cracked screen as it hits the surface with shards bursting; no body or reaching hand.
Phone back (camera lens) faces us, tilted at impact with shards exploding; the man is blurred in the background with the shh finger, and the screen is mostly hidden by the angle.
Wide eye-level shot: man squatting behind, looking at the phone already lying flat on the floor with the screen smashed and shards spread around; the aftermath, the whole room and plant visible.

simmers.grid.png: Front-facing medium shot, woman smiling as she holds the ladle above the pot with soup streaming off it, bowl in her other hand; whole pot and gas flame visible, but no nametag shown on her apron.
Wider three-quarter side view from the left, showing the counter and cabinets; the ladle is just above the pot, the woman is smaller in frame and the pot is pushed to the left; no nametag visible.
Tight close-up on the pot and a dipped ladle with bubbling soup and steam; the woman is cut off above the chest and her face is missing, and no nametag is visible.
High overhead top-down view looking into the pot at the ladle and bubbles; her head is cropped at the edge, the face is hidden, and there is no nametag.

Low front view with the ladle raised to her mouth, soup dripping off it and her eyes wide; the pot is at the bottom with soup lightly bubbling and steam rising; the apron is mostly hidden, so no nametag.

Over-the-shoulder rear view from the right, with her hair bun and the back of her head filling the frame; she pours soup from the ladle into a bowl, the pot is small in the background, and her chest and any nametag are hidden.
Right-side profile of the woman pouring ladle-fuls into a bowl, with the full pot below and a flame under it; she is mid-pour with her chest turned away, so no nametag shows.
Extreme close-up of her face with eyes closed, smelling the steam; the ladle is barely visible at the left, the pot sits at the bottom edge, and the apron is cropped so no nametag shows.

Wide shot with the woman seated on a chair, sipping from the ladle over a bowl, while the pot steams on the stove behind her at left; it is the latest moment in the action, and the apron shows no nametag.
snubbing.grid.png: Medium-wide eye-level shot with king in right profile, chin up, and whole snowy pub, chimney and sign visible beside the waving hand; king stays still, with no walking or crossed arms as in 7 or 9.
Tight low-angle shot looking up at king's chin and fur collar; pub is reduced to a sign and a sliver of wall, and the hand is cut off at the bottom edge, touching his cloak.
Eye-level, hand large in the foreground reaching toward king, who sits in the right third; pub is cropped to a sign and a lit window with a snowy roof, and king's body is cut off at the right edge.
Closest crop: king's face and crown fill the frame, with the crown tip cut off at the top; pub is just a small sign and a bit of roof, and the hand is small and cropped at the left.
High overhead view looking down on king's back and crown, with snowy ground and footprints; the only view that shows the whole pub roof and corner, but his face is mostly hidden.
Similar to 1 but pulled back to show the king's cloak down to the hem, and the pub is more cropped; hand is raised with motion lines, and king is in profile with eyes closed.
Close shot of king with arms crossed, medallion visible, haughty and clearly refusing the hand; pub is cropped at the left, and the hand is the smallest and cut off at the edge.
Wide shot with king walking away, seen from behind and the side with his face turned away; big hand in the foreground, pub sign and snowy mountains behind, and footprints in the snow.
Widest shot, king is tiny and fully turned away, walking off from behind with his face hidden; the whole snowy pub is visible along with footprints, and the hand is small at lower left.
spontaneous.grid.png: Wide side-on shot with the whole woman, knee on the bench and one hand on the table, glass raised. The full table and a few spawning fish are in view. Only cell 6 is as complete, and it is lower and more tilted.

Extreme low angle from beside the table, with the table reduced to a corner edge. The woman's knee-first climb is visible. No spawn or river is shown, so it hides the spawn that cells 1, 3 and 4 show.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind, looking down at the river. Four fish with clustered orange spawn are clearly visible. Her knee is barely visible and the table is only a sliver at the bottom. The beer is raised in front of the spawn.

High overhead angle looking down on the table top, with her knee on it. Fish and clustered spawn are in the upper right. It is the best view of the whole table from above, with her back to the camera.
Tight close-up of the glass and her knee, with her face cropped off at the top. Only two fish and some spawn are visible, and the table is just a strip of planks. It cuts off most of the woman.

Low-angle wide shot with her leaning far along the table and the glass high. Her leg stretches back to the ground, so her knee is not clearly the lead. The spawn is small and low in the frame, and the table and sky dominate.

Close-up with the huge glass in the foreground and her smiling face. Her knee is on the table, and two fish with spawn are visible at left. Most of the table is cropped, and it is the most glass-dominant of the nine.

Frontal wide shot with her standing, one foot planted on the table. It is not knee-first, since she is further along in the action, with one arm out and one arm up. A few fish with spawn are in the background, and the whole table is cut off at the bottom.

Closer three-quarter view from above, with her kneeling on the table and looking down at the camera. Two fish and some spawn are at lower left, and only a partial table is shown. Her face and glasses are prominent.

lines: Medium shot with the person in frame: shocked face, reaching toward the tipped mug as coffee pours out; spoon lies by the mug and the desk is partly covered in coffee, laptop and papers at the edges.

Extreme close-up of the desk edge: mug cut off at top left, spoon on the desk, coffee flooding over the edge in thick drips, a hand grabbing papers at right; no person's face and the whole desk is not shown.

High overhead view: mug tipped at top left, spoon lying clear on the desk beside it, and a big coffee puddle spreading across the desk toward the laptop and papers; no person, calm moment after the spill.
Tight close-up of the mug mouth with coffee pouring out and the spoon flying through the air at top right; desk barely visible and mostly cut off, with a sliver of a face at the bottom edge.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the person, who reaches a hand into the coffee; mug and spoon are small and far at the top, the desk is covered in coffee, and the person's head and back hide part of the desk.
Low, desk-level side view: mug tipped at left, spoon in the middle of a large puddle, and coffee flooding across the desk and dripping off the front edge; no person, with the chair behind.
Close-up of the mug with a hand holding the spoon at top left, coffee still pouring out of the tipped mug onto a small puddle; the desk is only a sliver and the person is not shown beyond the hand.

Side view from the end of the desk: person leaning in with an alarmed face and a '!' speech bubble, mug and spoon at the far desk edge with coffee falling to the floor; desk is shown but only a thin stream of coffee, not a flooded surface.

Wide full-room shot: the whole desk, chair, window and person standing back with raised hands; mug tipped at the far end, coffee flooding the desk and dripping onto a rug below; spoon is too small to see clearly.

stampede.grid.png: Eye-level front view of the panicked man mid-stride, with the DOORBUSTERS sign and open glass doors behind a clear crowd of four or five. Only one big sole is stomping, and the pee stain is faint and low-contrast. No visible puddle.
Extreme low-angle close-up on two big stomping soles with a clear dark wet patch on the pants. The crowd is only partial faces, and the doors, DOORBUSTERS sign and puddle are all cut off.

Low view from behind the runners with the stained seat in focus. He looks back over his shoulder toward the open doors, with two stomping feet framing the shot. The crowd is seen from behind, the DOORBUSTERS sign is missing and no puddle shows.

High overhead angle looking down on the man and crowd at the door mat. It is the only top-down view, with doors at the edges, and it cuts off the pants stain, the sign and any puddle. A second panel is cut off at the bottom.

Extreme low close-up of the huge red shoe with several other stomping shoes around it, so it has the most feet. The wet stain is visible, but the doors, sign, puddle and most of the crowd are cut off. A second panel strip shows at the bottom.

Side-on tilted shot of the man striding through the open door with the DOORBUSTERS sign and a tight line of shoppers behind him. The stain is clear, there are several stomping feet, and no puddle is visible. A second panel strip shows at the bottom.

Wide, deep shot inside the store with a long stream of eager shoppers and the DOORBUSTERS sign. The man's stained pants and a big stomping sole are in the foreground, but the doors are barely seen and there is no puddle.

Low-angle shot from the open doorway with the stained man lunging out as the crowd bursts through behind him. The door frames are prominent, and one sole stomps. The DOORBUSTERS sign is not visible and there is no puddle.

Later, calmer moment: the man stands still, hunched and looking down, embarrassed at his wet crotch, with both feet planted on the mat. The crowd rushes away behind him, so nothing is stomping, there is no sign, and the wet spot is the only pee shown.
steroid.grid-2.png: Eye-level full-body side view: doctor lunges in from the left with an arm out, annoyed patient glaring in the chair, red knee and bare foot in front; close to cell 8 but framed slightly tighter.
Dramatic low, worm's-eye angle from the floor: huge foot and glowing red knee dominate, doctor looms at upper left and patient is small at upper right.

Over the patient's shoulder: the patient's grey head and back fill the left, so his face and annoyance are hidden. The doctor crouches and reaches in, and the knee is a small red blob mostly blocked by the patient's arm.
High overhead view looking down: doctor leans in from the left with a raised arm, patient's scowl visible, red knee in the middle, and a curved arrow suggesting a circling motion.
Extreme close-up of the red, swollen knee with the doctor's hands pressing on it and the patient's scowl in the corner; the doctor's face and most of both bodies are cut off.
Patient is mid-shout with his arm thrown out, and the doctor recoils with both palms up, backing away. Knee is red but smaller. Wide side view that captures the reaction instead of the exam.

Calm exam moment: doctor crouches and touches the red knee while the patient sits with arms crossed, scowling. Both faces and the knee are all clearly visible, and it's the only one with actual contact and crossed arms.

Eye-level full-body front view like cell 1, with the doctor striding in from the left, the patient glaring, and the red knee and foot centred. The camera is a bit wider than cell 1, showing more of the room and the clinic sign.
Seen from behind the doctor, whose back fills the frame and whose face is hidden. The patient is mostly hidden behind the chair, with only grey hair visible, no face, and just a sliver of red knee.

lines: Medium shot from the front-left with the surgeon looking down at the incision; the small yellow lightning bolt by the wall panel is visible, and the headlamp beam is lit. Head tilted more than in cell 8.

Wide, far-back shot of the whole dark operating room with IV stands, stool and tray. The surgeon is tiny, and the bolt is a small spark at far left. It shows the most room of any cell and the least detail on the face.

Low-angle close-up looking up at the surgeon's wide-eyed, focused face, with the headlamp glowing at upper right. No lightning bolt is visible, and the room is mostly cut off apart from the edge of the surgical light.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind and to the left, showing the bun, the headlamp and the instrument tray at upper right. The face is mostly hidden, there is no bolt, and the room is not shown.

Top-down overhead shot with the surgeon's head bowed and the headlamp casting a bright circle on the drape. Both hands hold instruments and the tray is at left. The face is hidden and there is no bolt.
Extreme close-up of the eyes, glasses and glowing headlamp. Nothing else is visible: no bolt, no room, no hands.

Medium shot like cell 1, but the surgeon looks up and away toward the bolt, startled, with small alert marks by the headlamp. This is the reaction moment after the surge, and the bolt is clearly visible at the left.

Side profile facing left, with a second gloved hand passing an instrument in from the right. The lamp beam is lit and the monitor shows behind. There is no lightning bolt, and the room is mostly dark.

Front medium shot with the surgeon looking down and working, in a darker room than cell 1, with the IV stand at left and the beam lit. No lightning bolt is visible, and the shot is more centered than cells 1 and 7.

strutted.grid.png: Full-body side profile of the peacock striding left to right, with the whole fanned tail, a dust puff behind it and deep ruts in the road. It is the clearest all-in-one view, and its dust is lower and thinner than cells 7 and 8 show.

Close, low, slightly angled front view that crops the tail edges and cuts off the feet and the road. Only small dust puffs at the feet, and the ruts are barely visible, so the farm road is mostly hidden.
Top-down aerial view with the tail fanned wide behind the bird, facing the camera. Ruts run diagonally across the whole frame and there are small dust puffs, but no fence or horizon.
Extreme close-up of the head and neck with a sleepy, proud expression. The tail is cropped to a sliver, and the road, ruts and dust are all missing.
Rear view from directly behind: the tail is spread in a full symmetrical fan and the bird walks away along ruts. Only small dust puffs at the feet, with a fence at each side.
Extreme low close-up of the striding legs and talons, cropped at the belly. The thickest dust and the deepest rutted ground are shown, but the tail is mostly cut off and the head is missing.

Very wide distant shot straight down the road: the peacock is tiny with its tail fanned, under huge dust clouds in the sky. It shows the whole farm road with fences and ruts, but the bird is small and its swagger is hard to read.
Front-facing, eye-level medium shot of the peacock mid-stride, looking proud, with the tail fanned wide behind it. Dust trails at lower left and the ruts are partly cropped.

Side view from behind a blurred foreground fence post that covers the left side, with the peacock walking right. Its tail is fanned and a dust puff trails behind. The road is partly hidden and the ruts are faint.
sweep.grid.png: Side-on, eye-level full-body lunge with the arm reaching toward the broom, which is still untouched; the corner is a flat, shallow wall seam with little depth, and it's the earliest moment alongside cell 6.
Closer, slightly low side view of a crouched sprint with the hand just short of the broom; her far leg and the corner are partly cropped, so the corner reads shallow and the full body is not shown.

High rear three-quarter view looking into a deep, clearly receding corner with the floor and both walls visible; she stretches toward the broom, the feet cut off at the bottom-left and the face mostly hidden.

Steep overhead view with motion arcs showing her lunge toward the broom; the deep corner is visible as a floor-and-wall angle, but the broom is only partly in frame at the top right and her face is hidden.
Tight close-up cropping her body to the head and arm as her hand grips the broom handle; the corner is a flat wall seam, the swing hasn't started, and the broom is large.
Medium crouch with her hand just closing on the broom handle, the full body and the corner both visible; it's the grab moment, a step after cell 2 and before cell 7.

Side view of a full lunge with her arm up on the broom handle, the broom held upright against the corner; the corner is shallow, and it's the moment just after grabbing, with more of her legs than cell 6.
Extreme close-up with her determined face and fist on the broom, the brush filling the right side; the swing and the corner are mostly cropped out, and her body is cut off.

High three-quarter view of the swing itself, a wide stance with the broom sweeping across the floor and motion arcs; the deep corner is visible behind her, and it's the latest moment, the only one where she is actually swinging.
tacit.grid.png: Eye-level medium three-shot at the table: the man's hand pinches the $42 tab while the woman and bearded man sit silent beside him. Hand, tab and both seated people are all visible.
Tight, low close-up of the man's big hand grabbing the tab, with the two seated people small behind him. The hand is more dominant than in cell 1, and the seated people are cropped smaller.
Extreme close-up of only the hand pinching the tab beside a glass. No people at all, so the seated, silent diners are missing, unlike cells 1, 2 and 4.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind the two seated diners (backs and chairs), looking at the man reaching for the tab across the table. This is the only view from behind the seated people, and the hand and tab are small.
High top-down view of the round table: an arm reaches in from the top to grab the tab, with seated people at the bottom corners. They are partly cropped, and only their hands and heads show.
The man stands and holds the tab up in the air instead of grabbing it from the table. It is a later or different moment, and the hand is not grabbing.
Close-up of the woman resting her chin on her fist as a hand from the right edge holds the tab. The man's body is cut off, and the bearded man is missing.
Wide shot of the man walking away toward the counter with the tab, while the two seated diners watch from the left. It is the latest moment, and the hand is only a tiny grip on the tab.
Tight two-shot of the man holding up the tab next to the bearded man. The woman is missing, and it is held rather than being grabbed from the table.
trivial.grid.png: Medium side-on shot with the magician at left holding the red card up at the grinning judge, and the gavel visible; the magician's legs are cut off at the thighs, and no stage is visible.
Close-up from the magician's point of view: only his hand and card at left, with the judge's big laugh and gavel in clear view; the magician himself is not shown and no stage is visible.
Tight close-up with the card and hand filling the left and the judge small, laughing and half cropped at the bottom right; the magician and the gavel are missing, and no stage is visible.
Over-the-judge's-shoulder shot from behind, so the judge's smile is hidden and only the bald head and robe show; the magician smiles and holds the card up at center, and no stage is visible.

High overhead angle on the bench with the card lying face-up on the desk (the trick already done) and the gavel in view; the judge is a cropped head from behind with no smile visible, the magician is half cropped at upper left, and there is no stage.
Medium side shot with the magician offering the card while the judge rests his chin on both hands with a delighted, wide-eyed smile; the magician is cut off at the knees and no stage is visible.
Mid-trick moment with the card tossed in the air above the magician's reaching hands while the judge claps and laughs with a wide-open mouth; no stage is visible.

The magician leans in with his hand on his chest in a bow, holding the card up, while the judge laughs with his eyes shut and the gavel and bench are in view; his legs are cut off at the knees and no stage is visible.

Wide establishing shot from a doorway showing the magician's whole body, the full bench and the room, with the judge small and smiling and the card held out; this is the only one that hints at a tiny, minor stage area, though it still reads as a plain floor, and it has the smallest, least detailed faces.
toss.grid.png: Medium two-shot of the boss mid-toss with keys airborne between the two men; boss smiling, Tom's face and shoulder in view, but no nametag visible.
Tight close-up of the smiling boss with his hand and the keys just leaving it; Tom and his nametag are out of frame.
Low angle with Tom reaching up for keys high overhead; boss is smiling but cut off at the bottom left, and no nametag is visible.
Overhead POV from behind Tom's head, with his hands up and the boss's pointing hand cut off at top; the boss's face is not shown, so no smile, and no nametag.
Over-Tom's-shoulder shot with the boss smiling in the background and keys airborne at top right; Tom's back hides any nametag.
Extreme close-up of the keys alone in the air between two reaching hands; no faces, so no smiling boss and no nametag.
Boss holds the keys up in his hand, not yet thrown, so they are not airborne; he is smiling and Tom reaches in from the right, with no nametag visible.
Moment after the catch: Tom grins at the keys in his fist, boss smiling behind him; keys are no longer airborne and no nametag shows.
Widest full-body shot of the office with the boss tossing and the keys small in mid-air; the only view of both men's whole bodies, but Tom's chest is too small to read a nametag.
ultimately.grid.png: Medium shot of the baker smiling and holding the golden loaf up in both hands beside the brick oven, with the "LEE" tag visible and the burned loaves steaming on a tray in the foreground.
Low-angle shot of the baker hoisting the golden loaf overhead in triumph, with the "LEE" tag visible and the black loaves cropped along the bottom edge. No oven.
High-angle top-down shot of the tray: four burned loaves and one golden loaf, with the baker peeking over the counter and the "LEE" tag visible. The baker is the smallest part of the frame.
Wide side/back view of the baker sliding burned loaves into the brick oven with a peel. The face and the "LEE" tag are hidden, and the golden loaf sits at the tray's edge.
Close shot of the baker grimacing and inspecting a burned loaf, with the "LEE" tag visible. The golden loaf is half cut off at the bottom right edge and the other burned loaves sit on the tray.
Close-up of the baker offering the golden loaf on a peel with a smile, with the "LEE" tag visible. Burned loaves are only partly visible in trays at the corners.
Wide shot of the baker bowing or praying toward the golden loaf on a side table, seen from the side. The face and the "LEE" tag are hidden, and burned loaves are in a bin and on a tray.
Medium shot of the baker tossing a burned loaf toward a bin while cradling the golden loaf, eyes closed and smiling, with the "LEE" tag visible. Burned loaves are still on the tray.
Wide shot of the baker kneeling with arms raised and laughing, with the golden loaf on a table. The "LEE" tag is too small to read, and burned loaves are on two trays at the sides.
unwinding.grid.png: Medium-wide side view of the whole hammock between two trunks, with squiggly snore/dream lines by the head; person's hand rests on belly and the full body fits, unlike the tighter crops. No real thought bubble.
Low, looking-up angle from the foot end: huge bare feet dominate the foreground, hands behind the head, head small and far away; only one trunk and a bit of sky, no thought bubble.
Over-the-head view from behind: big dark hair fills the frame and the face is hidden, with feet raised in the distance; hammock is cropped and the relaxed expression is not visible.
High overhead bird's-eye shot of the whole hammock on grass, arm behind the head, both trunk ends visible; shows the full body and hammock shape but no sky and no thought bubble.
Extreme close-up of the smiling, eyes-closed face and shoulders; hammock is only orange fabric at the edges, so the hanging setup and the rest of the body are cut off. No thought bubble.
Medium side view with an arm dangling down to touch the grass and one trunk visible; the hammock is cropped at the right and legs are cut off. Motion swoosh marks are absent, no thought bubble.
Wide side view of the whole hammock between two trunks, with motion swoosh lines showing it gently swaying; smiling person with hand on belly, feet up, and grass in the foreground. No thought bubble.

Close side-on crop of the head and torso against sky and cloud, with a single curly wisp floating up from the head that is the closest thing to a drifting thought; legs and most of the hammock are cut off.
Very wide, distant shot with both trees, sky, clouds and the whole hammock tiny in the middle; the person is small, with feet up, and there are no dream lines or thought bubble.

lines: Wide shot of the whole room with the nurse walking in through the door at far left; her nametag is too small to read, and the baby is small at right with the hose running to it.
Medium shot from the machine's side with the nurse looking down at the baby; the "Venice" tag is clearly legible and the hose visibly reaches the baby's mask.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the nurse's head; her face and nametag are hidden or cut off, but the baby, hose and machine are all visible.

High overhead angle looking down into the crib; the nametag reads "Venice" only partly (it looks like "Venza"), and the baby is shown in full with the hose across the swaddle, one of her hands on the machine.
Tight close-up with the machine filling the left half; the nurse presses a button with her finger and the "Venice" tag is clear, but the baby is cropped to the lower right corner.
Side view with the nurse reaching across to touch the machine's screen; there is no nametag at all, and the baby and hose are fully visible, with the clock and a window behind.
Front-facing, eye-level shot from the foot of the crib with the nurse behind the crib, a night window behind her and the tag legible; the baby's face with the mask is large and central.

Close-up from the baby's side with the nurse's face large at upper left; her nametag is cut off at the bottom edge (reads "Venice" only in part), the machine is cropped at the right, and the baby and hose fill the foreground.
Balanced medium shot like cell 2 but wider, with the nurse behind the crib, the "Venice" tag clear, the machine at left, the baby fully visible and the window and clock behind.

wore.grid.png: Medium shot of the king strutting out of the castle doorway, with a banner, helmet and broken sword on the ground. Crown, pajamas and slippers are all visible. No nametag is visible.
Wide shot of the king strutting from the castle toward a battlefield with a white flag and wreckage. It shows the most setting of any cell. The king is small and has no visible nametag.
Low-angle, close view of the king mid-stride, with a huge slipper in the foreground and the castle tower at the left. It cuts off his legs and feet, and no nametag is visible.
Rear three-quarter view of the king from behind, facing a crowd of shocked soldiers and a white flag. The crown and pajamas show, but his face and chest are hidden, so any nametag is hidden too.
High overhead angle looking down on the king strutting along a stone corridor. It shows crown, pajamas and slippers, but no nametag and no battlefield.
Extreme close-up of the smiling bearded face and crown. It cuts off nearly all the pajamas and the body, and no nametag is visible.
Side profile, full-body shot of the king in mid-stride on the battlefield, with a plain background and debris. It's the clearest strut, and no nametag is visible.
Close-up of the stepping slipper and striped pajama legs beside a helmet and broken sword. It cuts off the king's head, crown and torso, so it shows no king, crown or nametag.

Front view of the king waving with one hand on his hip, surrounded by soldiers watching. Soldiers in the foreground partly block the view. It's a posed moment rather than a stride, and no nametag is visible.

lines: Medium shot from the front, with the whole tall hat, the pot and a rising steam wisp all in frame. The chef cocks his head and smirks while stirring, with the spoon tip just in the soup. It also shows a hanging pan and shelves, which most others lack.

Close, low-angle shot. The spoon is lifted out of the pot and dripping soup, and the pot is cut off at the bottom, so the bubbling surface is hidden. The hat's top is nearly touching the edge, and the chef looks sideways with a scheming smirk.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind-right. The chef looks back at the viewer with a devious smirk, and the tall hat is fully visible. The pot is cropped at the left, with the spoon stirring and steam rising, so the soup is only partly seen.

High overhead, top-down angle. The swirling soup fills the lower half, with the spoon stirring, and the chef looks up at the viewer. The hat is tilted and the pot is seen from above, which no other cell shows.

Extreme close-up on the face and shoulders. The hat top is cropped, and the pot is nearly out of frame except for a sliver of soup at the bottom. The spoon handle is held in the foreground, and the smirk and head cock are the main focus.

Medium shot with the chef leaning in and the head cocked. He covers his mouth or nose with his hand, as if snickering or sniffing, while stirring with the other hand. The hat is fully visible and the pot is mostly visible, but the soup is barely seen.

Side profile close-up. The chef sniffs or tastes a spoonful of dripping soup, and the hat is cropped at the top and left. The pot is partly cut off at the left with a long steam wisp, and the spoon is held up instead of stirring.

Tight shot dominated by the spoon stirring the swirling soup in the foreground. The chef's hat is heavily cropped at the top right, and the pot is only a rim and soup, with no steam. The smirk is visible.

Front medium shot where the chef holds a paper (a recipe) in his other hand and looks sideways at it, with a window behind. The expression is more skeptical than devious. The tall hat, spoon and pot with steam are all visible, and he is the only one holding a note.

Medium-wide eye-level shot of two campers by the fire, with one cob held up on a stick and another tossed mid-air above the fire, and a lake behind. The third camper is missing and no cob is on the ground.
Low-angle close shot of a bearded man throwing a bare cob and a woman holding a roasted cob on a stick. Only two campers are shown, and there is no tent or lake.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind a hatted camper holding a roasted cob on a stick, facing a beanie-wearing woman eating corn, with a tossed cob in the sky. The fire is cut off at the bottom corner, and the foreground camper is seen only from behind.

Top-down view of the fire ring with three campers cut off at the edges, two roasted cobs on sticks, and a bare cob lying on the ground at lower right. It is the only overhead shot and the only one with the cob already landed.
First-person view with an outstretched hand about to catch a big bare cob in the foreground. A smiling young camper with a roasted cob is at right, and the fire is low.
Close-up on a woman chewing on a cob in the left foreground, with a bearded man behind her tossing a cob up. The fire is not visible and the cob she is eating is bare-looking.

Close-up from a camper's point of view with a big roasted cob on a stick in the foreground, a bare cob in the air and a reaching hand. The bearded man is laughing in the background and a stone-ringed fire fills the bottom.

Wide shot with a young man mid-toss at left, the bearded man holding a roasted cob and a woman in a folding chair at right, with the tent behind. It shows all three campers and the whole scene, but the cob is small and caught high in the air.

Wide, low, eye-level shot with all three campers seated around the fire, and a huge bare cob lying in the foreground on the ground after being tossed. The ground cob dominates the frame, and the roasted corn is small, held by the campers.
Low rear view of two hikers climbing a slope toward the house, with a fairly large house and no ridge line beyond it; rain falling, and the people are shown from behind.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of a red-hooded hiker's back that blocks half the frame; the house is large and the people are mostly hidden, with no second person visible and no ridge.
High aerial view looking down on the house, the path and two tiny hikers, with the sea and the ridge edge visible; the only shot that shows the whole ridge top and the house tiny.
Close-up of a hiker's face shielding their eyes, with the house tiny in the distance on a ridge; only one person shown, and the moment is before they reach the house.
Close-up of the two hikers at the door as one grabs the knocker; the house is cut off to a wall and door, with no ridge or landscape visible, and the roof drips.
Wide, low-angle shot with the house large on the right and the two hikers tiny, far off at the left; the ridge is only a grass slope and the rain is lighter.
Tight close-up of the two smiling hikers under the eave, now sheltered and showing no sign of being soaked; the house is cropped to a wall and window, with only a sliver of rain at top right.
Interior doorway view from inside the house, with both hikers smiling in the doorway after arriving and the distant ridge and rain beyond; the house is cut off to the door frame.
Dynamic mid-shot of the two hikers rushing and slipping on the muddy path toward the door, with the house cut off to a wall and door; faces are alarmed, rain falls, and there is no ridge.

Wide eye-level shot of the whole scene: the woman on the left bank tossing crumbs, two ducks flying overhead and ducks in the foreground, with autumn trees. No signpost and no four-season tree, like all the others.

Close, low shot with a big duck flapping up out of the water in the left foreground. The woman, holding her paper bag, is cut off at the right edge, and three small ducks fly above. Closer than cell 1 and cell 7.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the woman's head and shoulder, looking out at the lake. Ducks swim and crumbs fall, but no ducks fly and her face is hidden. Autumn branch at upper left.
Top-down overhead view of seven ducks in a ring around the crumbs, with the woman's hand and bag at lower right. No sky, no trees and no flying birds.
Tight close-up of two open-beaked ducks catching crumbs, with the woman smiling and holding her bag at upper right. A loose line of dark birds flies at the top, and the scene is cropped tight.
Low-angle shot with the woman crouched at the shoreline, reaching out toward the ducks and smiling down at them. She is the closest and most central here, and no birds fly in the sky.

Wide shot of a duck splashing down mid-landing in the foreground, with a second duck also landing behind it. The woman is small at the far right and two birds fly above. Shows more water and more of the action than cell 2.

Shows a clear V-shaped line of seven ducks flying across the sky at the top. A big duck floats in the foreground while the woman, seen from behind at the right, reaches up toward them. Calmest moment, and the flight is the focus.
Close-up from the ducks' level with only the woman's hand and sleeve at the top, her face cut off. Crumbs fall in the air, one duck flaps its wings and gulps, and no ducks fly overhead.

Wide front view of both llamas sitting upright on the bed edge, heads tilted together, with the moon window visible. Both are fully in frame in matching striped pajamas, but they are awake-looking and calm rather than lying down.
Extreme close-up of the cream llama's face alone with eyes closed. The brown llama and the matching pajamas are cut off, so the pair is hidden and only a sliver of striped collar shows.
Top-down view of both llamas lying on the bed with heads on one pillow, asleep, with full striped pajamas and hooves visible. No window and no sitting.
Standing scene on a rug beside the bed. The cream llama is mid-yawn and the brown one holds a pillow, so neither is asleep. It's the only pre-sleep moment, and the bed is cut off to the side.
Both llamas sit on the bed edge slumped forward, heads drooping and eyes shut, with 'zzz' marks. This is the clearest nodding-off moment, with both pajama sets visible.
Over-the-shoulder close shot from behind the cream llama, whose back fills the left side and hides its face. Only the brown llama is smiling and sleepy, so the pair is not fully seen.
Tight close crop of both llamas sitting, heads leaning together, smiling and eyes closed. Pajama legs fill the bottom, and the bed and window are mostly cut off.
Front view of both llamas tucked under the pink blanket on pillows, with the moon window above. The blanket hides their pajama bottoms and legs, which cells 3 and 9 show.
Wide front view of the llamas on the bed, the cream one lying down asleep and the brown one sitting up with eyes closed. Full pajamas and hooves are visible, and the moon window is at upper right.

Street-level wide shot from the left, with a worried man in profile, the ambulance far off with lights and exhaust, and a crowd of sneezers inside and outside the lens: the most germ-heavy view alongside 8.
Close, tilted view with the ambulance cropped at the right edge and its lights glaring, only three sneezers in the lens and none outside it, so the flu spread looks small.
Bus-stop scene with a man in glasses seen from behind, a shelter and bench, and the ambulance rear-on in the distance, with a medium crowd in the lens and several outside.
High overhead angle looking down on sneezers on the pavement, with a bald man's head in the corner and the ambulance seen from above at the top right, partly cut off at the edge.

Extreme close-up where the lens fills most of the frame with four big sneezers, and the ambulance is a small cropped shape at the top right: it shows the fewest people overall and the least of the ambulance.

A doctor in a white coat holds the lens, and the ambulance is parked with its back doors open and a stretcher being loaded, so it is not revving. A slumped patient on a bench sits outside the lens, and only a few sneezers appear in it.
Close view with the ambulance head-on at the left, large and with headlights and exhaust, so it looks the most like it is revving; the lens shows just three sneezers and few people are outside it.
Wide, high-ish view of a long street with the ambulance tiny in the distance, a woman seen from behind, and many sneezing pedestrians walking outside the lens, so the flu looks the most widespread.

Seen from indoors through a doorway with a plant and a red-cross sign, the ambulance is parked with paramedics standing beside it and no exhaust, so it is not revving; the lens shows four sneezers and a few people stand outside.
Medium front-on shot of the rat mid-pour, scooping grain into the second bowl with a wary sideways glance. All four equal bowls and the tail are visible, with shelves behind.
Tight close-up that crops the rat's body and shows only three bowls. It pours grain with a furrowed, careful look, and the fourth bowl and tail are cut off.
Extreme side angle looking down the table at four bowls receding into the distance. The rat is a huge cropped shape at left, with no scoop, no pour and no apron.
High, overhead-ish angle with a bow on the rat's head, showing four evenly filled bowls from above. The rat leans over the scoop, and the lower edge has a stray cropped strip.
Extreme macro on one bowl and part of a second. The rat's snout and paw are cropped as it prods a grain with a finger. The other bowls are cut off, so the even piles can't be compared.
Rat holds up two bowls and compares them, frowning. Only these two bowls are shown, so the row of equal piles is hidden, and it has no scoop or table.
Eyes-closed rat wiping its brow with a cloth after finishing, holding the scoop at its side. All four bowls are evenly filled, which makes it the relaxed aftermath, not the pouring.
Mid-pour like cell 1, but a grey second rat stands at right with paws clasped and watching. The pour, the four equal bowls and the cautious rat are all visible.
Calm, eyes-closed rat stands upright with its hands on the table and the scoop set down. Four even bowls show, and it's a still moment after the work, with no pouring.
Wide, eye-level shot of both cooks stirring and holding herbs beside a fire-lit cauldron. The soldier is a small, cropped figure at the right, and there is no steam.
Close, low-angle shot with the cauldron and sign dominant. The soldier's face is cut off at the right, the stew surface is hidden, and steam rises between the cooks.
Over-the-shoulder view from behind the soldier's helmet, with steam rising and the stew visible. The soldier's face is hidden, and the bowl is held up in the foreground.
High overhead angle looking down into the steaming stew with chunks visible. Both cooks are shown from above, and the soldier is cropped to a helmet and bowl in the corner.
Tight close-up on a ladle lifting chunky stew. The first cook's head is cut off at the top, and the soldier is partly cropped at the right.
Wide shot with the second cook sprinkling herbs into the pot. The soldier is only partly shown at the right, and the stew is lightly visible.
Only one cook, on the left, with no second cook. The soldier is large at the right, and the cauldron's stew surface is hidden behind the sign and pot rim.
Wide action shot of the two cooks carrying the steaming cauldron on a pole, with the soldier walking alongside. It is the only picture where everyone is moving and full-length, with sandals visible.
Close-up of the soldier sipping from a spoon, with cooks small in the background. The soldier is the focus, and the stew is partly hidden behind the rim.
Wide front-on shot of the stern landlord on the stoop holding up the House Rules sheet and raising a palm at a brown-haired tenant seen from behind; full body and sign visible, no nametag.
Close-up from over the tenant's dark-haired head as the scowling landlord jabs a finger at the House Rules sheet taped to the door; sign clear, no nametag, landlord cut off at the chest.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the landlord, who is cropped to cap and shoulder, holding the House Rules paper toward a startled woman; his face and stern look are hidden, no nametag.
Tightest close-up of the landlord's angry face and pointing finger beside the House Rules sheet, with only a sliver of the tenant's head and glasses; his waist is cropped, no nametag.

High overhead view of the landlord leaning over a table and pressing his hand on the House Rules sheet, which his hand partly covers; his face is hidden under the cap, so he doesn't look stern, and there is no nametag.
Rear view of the landlord climbing the steps with a rolled-up paper while a woman peeks out the door; his face is hidden and the sign isn't posted or readable, with no nametag.
Landlord seen from behind and the side as he pins the House Rules sheet to the door, with a brown-haired tenant in the foreground; his face is mostly hidden, so no clear stern look, and no nametag.
Wide shot of the landlord walking away down the steps after posting the House Rules sign on the door, while a woman watches from the right; his eyes are downcast, and no nametag is visible.
Medium close-up of the landlord slapping his palm on the House Rules sign with an exclamation bubble, facing a wide-eyed brown-haired tenant; sign clear, no nametag.

Full-length, eye-level side-on shot of the whole room: the sinner stands at left, hand to mouth and looking at the mirror, and the whole mirror stands at right with the twin in a gentle open-handed gesture. The twin's mouth is open, but the sinner's mouth is covered.

Tilted low-angle shot looking up, with the mirror frame slanted. The sinner is cut off at the legs and the twin at the waist. The twin points a finger up (like cell 7 and cell 8), and the sinner's hand covers their mouth.

Tight close-up over the sinner's shoulder: we see the back of their head, and their face is hidden, so the sinner is not seen watching. The twin has an open, speaking mouth and open-handed gestures, and the mirror frame is mostly cropped out.

High-angle overhead view looking down on the sinner's hunched back, with their face hidden and the mirror tilted. The twin is full-length with open arms and a speaking mouth, and this is the only view from above.

Extreme close-up of two profiles nose to nose, with no mirror and no full bodies. Both mouths are open and speaking, one with a wide grin, each with a 'THE SAME WORDS' bubble below. It shows the mouths most clearly but loses the mirror and the sinner's watching eyes.

Medium shot from the sinner's side, with their wide eyes fixed on the mirror and their hand on their chest, so the mouth is not covered. The twin shows an open-handed gesture. The mirror is partly cropped at the right edge.

Medium shot from behind and to the side, with the sinner hunched and a hand over their mouth, glancing at the mirror. The twin gives a thumbs-up or point and is shown from the waist up; the twin's legs are visible at the bottom.

Close frontal shot of the sinner's worried face, with their hand at their chin and eyes on the mirror. The twin is on the right, pointing a finger up, and the framing is tight so the twin's body is cut at the waist.

Close medium shot with the sinner on the left grinning and mirroring the twin's open-handed pose, hand on chest. This is the only cell where the sinner's mouth is open and smiling in sync with the twin, so the pair look truly mirrored, not watched.

Full-body wide shot at street level at dusk: the man lunges forward with a loose shoelace while the date waits smiling by the lit doorway, and both are fully visible, unlike the tight crops in 2, 5 and 9.
Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the man's huge sole in the foreground, with the date small and worried at right, so his stumble is exaggerated and his legs are foreshortened.

Indoor hallway shot from behind the date's head and shoulder, with the man falling away from her down the corridor, so his face is hidden and the date is shown only from behind and not waiting at a door.

High overhead bird's-eye view of the sidewalk: the man sprawls with his untied shoe flung off and his face hidden, the date is seen from above at top right, and a parked car is visible, which no other cell shows.

Extreme close-up of the man's panicked face and outstretched hand filling the frame, with the date small and blurred behind; his legs and the trip cause are cut off, unlike the full-body cells 1, 6 and 7.

Wide shot at a doorstep where the man trips over a green garden hose, one leg kicked up in mid-fall, while the date watches delighted from the right. It is the only cell that shows the hose as the cause.
Side-on full-body shot of the man mid-stumble, bent low with his untied lace trailing, while the date covers a laugh at right against plant pots, with no door or street lamp.
Wide shot at a café door with a chalkboard sign: the man wobbles with arms flung wide and a loose shoelace while the date laughs openly, hands clasped. Her amusement is clearer than in 1 or 7.

Close-up of the date's smiling face in the foreground, glancing back over her shoulder, while the man stumbles small and out of focus behind her. She dominates and his trip is barely legible, unlike the other cells.

Medium side-on shot from the car's front-left: the mechanic points and shouts with an exclamation bubble while the driver leans out of the window, and the whole red bald tire is visible with its tread worn smooth.

Tight close-up on the tire: only a pointing hand and sleeve appear, with no mechanic's face, and the driver is small and distant in the window, so it shows the smooth tread most clearly but cuts off the mechanic.

Low-angle shot from the front-left: the mechanic points and the driver peers out, and the whole bald tire and the car's front are visible, with no speech bubble and a more dramatic perspective than cell 1.

Top-down bird's-eye view: the mechanic runs toward the car and the driver leans out, but the tire is a thin red sliver at the front wheel, so the bald tread is barely visible, unlike every other cell.

Over-the-mechanic's-shoulder shot: the mechanic's cap and back fill the left side, a hand points at the tire, and the driver looks alarmed in the window, with the tire cropped at the bottom and right edges.

Mechanic rushes alongside the moving car with hands up and an exclamation bubble, and the driver sits at the wheel looking stern rather than scared, which is the only cell where he does not look warned, with the bald tire at the bottom.

Mechanic crouches and rubs the smooth tread by hand while the driver stands beside him with a hand on his mouth, and the tire is shown at the left edge, so it focuses on checking the tread, not on warning.

Shot from inside the car over the dashboard: the driver's frightened face fills the left, the mechanic points through the window with an exclamation bubble, and the bald tire is only a cropped red band in the foreground.
Aftermath: the driver crouches with his head in his hands in distress while the mechanic comforts him, and the bald tire is on the left, so this is the latest moment with no pointing or warning.
